weight_semantics: POptimizeRadial passes explicit groupweights; GetAverageConfig normalizes supplied weights and averages configurations within each group. Explicit weights bypass runtime acfg_wmode2 summed-abs-sweight default.
manual_runtime_discrepancy: Manual says omitted groupweights equal; pin radial.c defaultmode2 uses summed abs cfg.sweight. Preserve both; do not rely on omission.

separate cold B/C mode0 rates/exact wavefunction guards/fresh complete channels/raw-formula-table audit
